title: OTHRYS OS Component Contracts and anti-drift lint
objective: Create one compact machine-checkable component contract for every current house surface and prove contract/Book/manifest alignment without changing runtime authority or product capability.
problem: Current Books explain purpose and history, but component ownership, IO, dependency, authority, loop and failure boundaries are not yet expressed in one compact machine-checkable anti-drift contract per current surface.
outOfScope: No new resident, Titan, model, integration or product capability
risks: Contracts duplicate Books and drift independently
A contract is misread as authority
Recurring components omit bounded Loop Laws fields
laws: Book = what/why/history/boundary; Component Contract = operational anti-drift interface.
Every current Book target has exactly one component contract.
A contract cannot grant authority or certify its own implementation.
Loop fields follow LOOP_LAWS.md and may explicitly declare NONE when a component is not a recurring loop.
Evidence must point to current repo truth.
Quarry-only surfaces must not acquire contracts by documentation.

tasks.title: Define required operational and loop fields without Book duplication

slices.title: Cover every current house surface exactly once

tasks.title: Materialize contracts from current Book/manifest truth
Fail on missing, extra, malformed, authority-drifting or unbounded contracts
